answer: Because the timing is entered against the terrace challenge, the willow audit can replay the ocean history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 98 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2881 identities would post 2708 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
